items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Zero-Day RCE (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: Adobe released an emergency security update for a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650), dubbed StyleSmuggler, in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated remote code execution and is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw abuses Magento's template-processing functionality to inject and execute malicious PHP code, often triggered by a failed payment email.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to the updates in this bulletin.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92 as isolated patch files, fixing seven vulnerabilities including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. This update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVE-2026-53787) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-45247 and rated 9.8 (critical).
